### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Default: **per registration**. Harness variables select test arms and evidence provenance; they are not new hydro schemes.
`SNAPY_BUILD_CUDA=0` is installed for non-CUDA builds even if a GPU is visible.
:::

| variable | purpose |
|---|---|
| `SNAPY_BUILD_CUDA` | suppress unavailable CUDA arms |
| `GTEST_FILTER` | select exactly one seam case per registered arm |
| `BLOCKS_PER_PROCESS` | exchange topology size |
| `EXPECT_LOCAL_NEIGHBOR`, `EXPECT_REMOTE_NEIGHBOR` | assert selected exchange topology |
| `SNAPY_RUN_HYDRO` | locate the cycle-abort test executable |
| `WB_REF_WALL_DUMP`, `WB_REF_WALL_BETAS` | wall-reference scan/dump aids |

`SNAPY_TEST_PYTHONPATH` is a CMake cache path, not one of these solver variables. The generated test environment
prepends it while retaining the caller's path.

### Derivation

No numerical derivation applies. A selected test must actually execute its assertion: a filter that selects no tests
cannot certify a scheme. The seam-arm registration therefore requires a one-test pass marker, and Python CUDA arms
use skip code 125 when unavailable.

### Numerical method

Register the arm with its environment, select its case, verify its execution marker, then interpret its assertions.
Record disabled and skipped tests separately from passes. Supply all scheme flags explicitly or unset them before
starting evidence runs: inherited user environment can otherwise contaminate a nominal default arm.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch12-test-environment-flow
#| fig-cap: "Test harness environment: labelled boxes show inputs and decisions in evaluation order. This is a configuration or stencil diagram, not measured data."
#| fig-alt: "CTest arm environment; one selected test; assert execution marker; pass / fail / skip."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch12.fig_test_environment_flow import make_fig
make_fig()
```
